Summary: PRE01 - Customer account must be registered
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. Summary

Before running customer login test cases, the customer account must be properly set up and accessible in QA.

h3. Context

This issue describes the prerequisites needed before executing customer login test cases.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Customer must have an account in the application.
* Customer account must be active.
* Customer email must be registered.
* Tester must know the valid test credentials.
* Customer login application must be accessible in QA.

h3. Other information

Test data:

* Password: customer@123

Environment: QA
